title: fix(sdk): reject already-aborted signals before dispatch
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16114

- Rejects already-aborted caller signals before the SDK invokes fetch, preventing unwanted generation requests.
- Preserves PollinationsError CANCELLED/status 499 for default and custom abort reasons through the existing error handler.
- Adds text/chat regressions proving zero fetch calls and checks in-flight cancellation; all 100 SDK tests, typecheck, build and Biome pass.
- Confirms zero requests against a real loopback HTTP server with the built SDK and a dummy key; normal requests still succeed.

gist.headline: Stop means before fetch
gist.blurb: An already-cancelled request stops at the SDK door instead of wandering off to generate something. The cancellation still comes back as CANCELLED, status 499.
gist.summary: The SDK rejects already-aborted caller signals before invoking fetch, preventing unwanted text and chat generation requests while preserving PollinationsError CANCELLED/status 499 for default and custom abort reasons.
gist.impact: Cancelling before dispatch sends zero requests; in-flight cancellation and normal requests continue to work.
